entities.page_title: EXPANSION OF INTERVIEW WAIVER ELIGIBILITY FOR VISA APPLICANTS FROM PAKISTAN
entities.title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for Visa Applicants from Pakistan
entities.summary: The United States Mission to Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for certain applicants of F, J, H, and L visas. Pakistani citizens who previously held U.S. visas are eligible to use this program.
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who previously held U.S. visas
application_process: Applicants may visit our website to determine if they are eligible for an interview waiver
important_notes: Some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear at the U.S. Embassy or U.S. Consulate General for interviews after submitting their applications
